_about: The Persian meanings of the vocabulary, written by hand.
The PDF has no Persian text layer at all: the vocabulary pages carry only the English
words and their example sentences, in Times New Roman and Comic Sans, with no Arabic
font anywhere in the document.  The printed Iranian textbook shows the meaning beside
each word, but that half of the page is simply not in this file, so the meanings here
are supplied rather than extracted - the one part of the content tree that is not read
The keys are the words exactly as the book prints them, including its capitalisation,
because that is what the extractor produces and what the reader matches on.  A key the
book no longer prints is a stale entry and fails the build; a word the book prints
without a key here is reported so the gap is visible rather than silent.
